p.note: Top of page, in brown ink by Kort Rogge: Hunc lactantium emi Ego Conradus Roggo in almo studio perusino a quodam scriptore famulo domini johannis pertruzij de monte sperello legum doctoris famosissimi pro quinque ducatis in quinternis quem postea ligare feci pro medio ducato Anno domini mcccclx in mense decembris
In pencil by a modern hand: Domkyrkobibl. Strängnäs

binding.p: The binding was repaired by Sven Wiklander in the 1950s.

provenance.p: Commissioned by Kort Rogge during his studies in Canon Law in Perugia, as stated by a note on . His coat of arms is found on . The manuscript was first mentioned in Barkman's catalogue of .

acquisition.p: Most likely donated to Strängnäs Cathdral by Kort Rogge.
